svg.text: Overall is solid, Part 1 is lighter, and Part 2 is hatched. Black lines show rollout min-to-max.
Judge model: DeepSeek V4 Pro. Q15 uses the corrected golden.
Data notes: Q15 is overlaid with the 2026-07-19 corrected golden; all other task scores are reused byte-for-byte.
[1] B. Razavi, "Analog Design Experiments With AI--Part 1," IEEE Solid-State Circuits Magazine, Fall 2025.
[2] B. Razavi, "Analog Design Experiments With AI--Part 2," IEEE Solid-State Circuits Magazine, Spring 2026.
